title: Object Storage: outage credit — Enterprise Support eligibility
content:
For Object Storage outage credit, read portfolio discount fraction from the tier of the active support contract with the same customer and legal billing entity; use zero when no such contract exists.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage credit in this situation? Read portfolio discount fraction from the tier of the active support contract with the same customer and legal billing entity; use zero when no such contract exists.
